messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — metering emitter showing 30-45% lower token counts for a subset of customers since 11:10 UTC. Investigating.

samir.m: seeing the same in the shadow stream (shadow-agg). counts drop at ~11:09 then resume at 11:22 for most shards.

leena: initial glance — sidecar-heartbeat logs show repeated `heartbeat lost` across 3 replicas around 11:08-11:12. might be sidecar restart spam.

maria_g: tagging billing team — @billing-lead could this cause false overage flags downstream?

billing-lead: could, yes. if emit gaps -> downstream aggregates see lower totals then backfilled spikes can create charge anomalies. need to confirm duplicate/backfill behavior.

ops-oncall: i'm going to restart the emitter sidecar on the affected zone, rolling one at a time. command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/metering-sidecar -n telemetry --selector=zone=eu-west-1a`

samir.m: logs (redacted):
```
2026-03-17T11:08:52Z WARN sidecar heartbeat missing seq=12487
2026-03-17T11:09:01Z ERROR emitter flush failed: context canceled
2026-03-17T11:11:30Z INFO emitter reconnected, replay window=13
```

leena: replay window of 13 looks suspicious; could explain short-term undercount then backfill surges. checking dedupe keys.

maria_g: quick check — which customers are affected? I see 4 orgs in the alert: org_42, org_99, org_omega, org-external-7. Mostly long-running streams.

billing-lead: action items: 1) confirm whether backfill duplicates previous tokens 2) assess whether customers saw overage flags 3) decide credit/no-credit.

ops-oncall: restarted one replica at 11:16, second at 11:18. sidecars show steady heartbeats again by 11:19.

samir.m: toggled emitter fallback to queued-mode (helps avoid drop) at 11:20: `POST /internal/emitter/fallback?mode=queued` — responded 200.

leena: running recon job to compute pre/post deltas: `python tools/recon/compare_window.py --start 11:00 --end 11:30 --orgs org_42,org_99,org_omega,org-external-7`

incident-bot: Note: severity de-escalation candidate if no customer-visible errors in 30m.

maria_g: quick customer impact check — org_42 reported an alert at 11:25 about a billing spike, probably from backfill. others haven't flagged.

billing-lead: copy. get me the recon output and raw emitter deltas. if it's double-counts for org_42 we need to prepare a correction + a customer message.

samir.m: recon summary (11:00-11:30): org_42: -42% during 11:09-11:19 then +1.1x bump when backfilled at 11:22. org_99: -38% gap, but no net overcount (dedupe worked). org_omega: -12% transient. org-external-7: unaffected in net.

leena: dedupe keys for org_42 had a TTL mismatch in our cache (kv-ttl=5m vs emitter-window=13m) — race allowed replays to be treated as new. root cause hypothesis: sidecar restarts + misconfigured TTL.

ops-oncall: created quick PR to align TTLs, will roll after low traffic window: PR #5421.

billing-lead: mitigation plan: 1) mark org_42 events between 11:09-11:25 as "suspect" in billing ledger 2) run de-dup pass to remove replayed tokens 3) notify customer with clear timeline and planned credit if needed.

maria_g: customer comms draft in #support-drafts, pinging @support for approval.

incident-bot: Update: sidecar heartbeat flapping resolved, emitter fallback still on. remaining tasks: dedupe pass, PR rollout, postmortem.

samir.m: running dedupe job now — command: `airflow trigger_dag metering_dedupe_v2 --conf '{"org":"org_42","start":"2026-03-17T11:00","end":"2026-03-17T12:00"}'`

leena: dedupe run confirmed — removed 1.03M tokens (0.9% of org_42 daily). ledger adjusted.

billing-lead: ledger scrub shows final billed tokens back to expected baseline. we'll issue a 100% credit for the suspect window and the support team will send the note.

maria_g: support note sent at 12:03 UTC. subject: "Billing correction: brief emitter replay affected your usage" — includes timeline + credit details.

ops-oncall: PR #5421 merged and scheduled for 02:00 UTC deploy (low traffic).

leena: root cause: sidecar restarts (auto-restart loop from a transient network hiccup) + TTL mismatch = dedupe failure. follow-ups: add automated TTL sanity check, improve emitter fallback detection, add runbook step to triage dedupe risk.

billing-lead: closing incident when postmortem is published. assign postmortem to @leena and @samir.m.

samir.m: ack. I'll capture timelines, logs, and the dedupe job output.

incident-bot: Incident closed as mitigated at 12:10 UTC. Postmortem ETA: 2026-03-19. :white_check_mark:
